title: Ep 42: How Multi-Agent AI Architecture Replaces 80% of Repetitive Agency Operations
speaker: Alexander Hayes (Chief AI Architect)
transcript_excerpt: When we looked at agency client retention, the biggest failure mode was silent automation decay. A webhook breaks at 2 AM, nobody notices for five days, and the client churns. Multi-agent systems with active self-healing solve this because you have an agent that monitors the other agents. Secondly, lead response times under 90 seconds increase deal close rates by 391%. By wiring lead qualification directly into WhatsApp and CRM before human review, agency margins jump from 25% to 58%. The key is human-in-the-loop: AI proposes, humans approve.
